Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

bindings.title: Select the Notion databaseId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Event Database", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Append Audit Row (Notion), Load Previous Snapshot, Load Previous Snapshot 2, Update Changed Rows, Write Fresh Snapshot and pick the real databaseId from the list.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Event Tracker", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Archive Row Snapshot, Park in Dead-Letter Queue and pick the real documentId from the list.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URL "enrichment.example.com" is illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace it with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Update Changed Rows" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Every Few Minutes" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

credentials.detail: Needed by 3 nodes: Append Audit Row (MySQL), Handle 'job.start' → MySQL, Log Unrecognized Kind. The file ships with no credentials attached, so the selector on each of these is empty on import.

credentials.title: Set up Twilio SID + token
credentials.detail: Needed by the node: Escalate Failure to Twilio. The file ships with no credentials attached, so the selector on each of these is empty on import.

behaviour.title: Replace the Twilio sender number
behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: Set the environment variables, or inline the values
behaviour.detail: This template reads $env.TRELLO_LIST_ID. Environment variables are not exposed to expressions on n8n Cloud at all, and on self-hosted they are unset until you add them - in both cases the expression falls through to its literal fallback rather than erroring, so the call is made against a placeholder.
